description: Repairs r-sql-1/union-types: ND was never created (3292). Asks what common output Field type, size, precision and value types UNION gives for Currency and the stored Decimal x of ND in both arm orders, and UNION ALL in both orders (ACCDB; the MDB file is not repaired here). Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-sql1 is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
